# Bajaj Finserv Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Budget spent on searches/documents (6 searches, 5 documents fetched, 3 web pages read). Statutory CSR annexures for BFS Limited standalone were found for all three years, but the itemised CSR project list (Annexure with implementing-agency/district-level detail referenced as 'CSR projects approved by the Board') was not fetched, and BRSR-hosted PDFs on bseindia.com/nseindia.com were HELD sources not read. PAN, CSR-1 registration number and Darpan ID were not located; beneficiary-count metrics were seen but without a value cleanly attachable to a single named metric so were omitted rather than guessed.

Bajaj Finserv Limited (CIN L65923PN2007PLC130075) is the BSE/NSE-listed core investment holding company of the Bajaj Group's financial-services businesses (Bajaj Finance, Bajaj Allianz Life/General Insurance, Bajaj Housing Finance etc.), headquartered in Pune, incorporated 2007. As a standalone entity its own Section 135 CSR obligation is small (average net profit ~₹26-36 crore across FY2023-FY2025, prescribed CSR ~₹0.5-0.7 crore, actual spend ₹0.38-0.99 crore per year) because its standalone profit is modest relative to the wider group. Its CSR narrative brand 'Bajaj Beyond' spans skilling (Skillserv, CPBFI, Project Odiserv, PanIIT/PARFI) and child wellbeing (Maha Smiles cleft care with Smile Train India, Type 1 Diabetes care with HCJMRI Hospital, paediatric heart care with Sai Sanjeevani Hospitals) but the ₹335.73 crore / 265-project figure quoted on the FY2025 annual report CSR page is materially larger than the standalone statutory annexure and appears to be a group-wide (Bajaj Finserv + subsidiaries) figure, consistent with an FY2023 annexure note stating beneficiary counts are cumulative across Bajaj Finserv Ltd. and its subsidiaries. This distinction between the tiny standalone statutory spend and the large group-branded narrative spend is the most important finding to flag for downstream use.

Website: https://www.bajajfinserv.in/corporate-bajaj-finserv
